transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, a clinical conversational agent. I conducted your post-cataract surgery follow-up check, and I'm here to answer any questions you may have about your recovery. Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, Dora! Yes, I do have some questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start light exercise, such as gardening, about 1 week after surgery. Just be sure to avoid getting any water in your eyes, and take it easy at first. It's also a good idea to wear protective eyewear when gardening. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should start using the preservative-free eye drops I recommended as soon as you can, ideally 4 times a day. This will help with dryness and discomfort. If you're running out, you can get some more from your GP. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild, just wearing sunglasses when you're outside should help. But if it's severe or accompanied by redness and pain, we may need to check it further. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

transcript.text: It's common to still have some blurriness, especially in the first week after surgery. But it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it's okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the information, Dora. I don't have any more questions for now.

transcript.text: I'm glad I could help answer your questions. Now, just to confirm, have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered?

transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you!
